items.name: Flo period tracker app privacy
items.who: Used the Flo app between Nov 2016 and Feb 2019 and entered period or pregnancy info.
items.details: You attest you used the app; no screenshots or receipts. California users get a double share.

items.name: VSL#3 probiotic
items.who: Bought VSL#3 probiotic in the US between June 1, 2016 and June 19, 2019.
items.details: No proof: $20 for one unit, one per household. With receipts: up to $800.

items.name: Pork price-fixing (bacon, raw pork)
items.who: Bought bacon or raw pork at a grocery store for your household between June 28, 2014 and June 30, 2018.
items.details: No receipts; you attest to what you bought. Covers 24 states plus DC, so confirm your state first.

items.name: Bestway above-ground pools
items.who: Bought a new Bestway pool 48 in. or taller (Power Steel, Steel Pro, Coleman Power Steel) from 2008 through 2024.
items.details: $40 with no receipt, one per household, or 10% of what you paid with a receipt.

items.name: ConnectOnCall data incident
items.who: Contacted a healthcare provider or their office after hours between May 12, 2014 and May 12, 2024.
items.details: No notice needed. Up to $75 with no documents, or up to $5,000 with loss documents, plus 2 years of medical data monitoring.

items.name: Forbes.com website trackers
items.who: California residents who visited a Forbes site between Dec 20, 2023 and June 11, 2026.
items.details: Filing route for people with no Class Member ID; nothing to upload.

items.name: CVS website and app privacy
items.who: Used cvs.com, cvshealth.com or the CVS app in the US before July 27, 2026.
items.details: This is the no-notice form. Up to $5 with no documents or $10 with proof. One per household.

items.name: Raging Waters ticket processing fees
items.payout: Pro rata, based on fees paid
items.who: Bought tickets on ragingwaters.com between June 1, 2020 and June 22, 2026 and paid a processing fee.
items.details: Pick the no-notice option. Claims are checked against park records, so use the contact info you bought with.

items.name: Laboratory Services Cooperative data breach
items.who: Had lab testing ordered by a Planned Parenthood health center, paid for someone's testing, or worked for LSC.
items.details: Notice ID optional. Up to $5,000 if you document out-of-pocket losses.

items.name: Dr. Squatch "natural" labeling
items.who: Bought any Dr. Squatch product labeled "natural" between Nov 1, 2018 and Aug 29, 2026.
items.details: $0.50 per product, up to 5 with no receipt, one per household. Choose "I do not have a Settlement Claim ID."

items.name: Kroger prescription pricing
items.who: Filled a prescription at a Kroger pharmacy (or affiliate) using insurance between Dec 9, 2018 and Aug 23, 2026.
items.details: Pick the band matching your out-of-pocket spend. Under $8,000 needs no documents up front.

items.name: Apple Intelligence Siri features
items.who: Bought an iPhone 16, 16e, 16 Plus, 16 Pro, 16 Pro Max, 15 Pro or 15 Pro Max in the US between June 10, 2024 and March 29, 2025.
items.details: No notice needed. Have the serial number (Settings, General, About) or the Apple Account email or phone. One claim per device.

items.name: Non-bank ATM surcharge fees
items.who: Paid a surcharge with a debit or ATM card at a non-bank ATM between Oct 24, 2007 and Aug 14, 2026 and wasn't fully reimbursed.
items.details: Estimate how many surcharges you paid. No documents to file; the administrator can ask for statements later.
